subject: Observability bundle commercial sourcing — next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@grafana.com>, Matt O'Neill <matt.oneill@datadog.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability bundle commercial sourcing — next steps

Hi Sarah, Matt —

Thanks again for jumping on last week. As discussed, we want to explore a lightweight commercial bundle that pairs Redwood's inference monitoring hooks + Grafana dashboards and Datadog managed alerts for joint customers. The goal is a co-marketable package that:

- Provides out-of-the-box dashboards and alerting templates for latency/cost spikes
- Includes a reseller-friendly SKU and 90-day pilot pricing
- Has a simple mutual action plan so our field teams can sell together

I've attached a first-pass spec and a sample term sheet (partner-draft-sku-v1.pdf, commercial-term-sheet.xlsx) — high level commercial asks are in the sheet. Can we align on a tech + commercial sync this week? Proposed times: Wed 9/22 10:00am PT or Thu 9/23 2:00pm PT.

Action items I think we need after sync:
1) Decide packaging tiers (pilot / standard / enterprise)
2) Agree on reseller margins and crediting model
3) Create a short co-sell play / one-pager for field teams
4) Draft an SOW template for pilot engagements

Ben / Laura — looping you for any GTM constraints or integration concerns.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Partnerships (Observability)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: partner-draft-sku-v1.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: commercial-term-sheet.xlsx (Excel)

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@grafana.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700

On Tue, Sep 21, 2027 at 9:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Sarah, Matt —
> 
> Thanks again for jumping on last week...

Karthik — thanks for the clear summary and the materials. Grafana is keen to explore a packaged offer that presents a low-friction ops experience for customers adopting LLM features. A few quick notes from our side:

- Tech: we can provide a reference dashboard and a packaged plugin to visualize KV cache heatmaps, per-model token latency, and token-cost breakdowns. Our integration engineers estimate ~2-3 weeks for a supported dashboard bundle (includes test datasets).
- Commercial: pilot pricing and a co-sell play look fine; we'll need to confirm channel crediting with our commercial ops.
- Legal/procurement: we typically need a short MSA addendum + SOW for pilots. If Redwood can pre-fill a draft SOW, that accelerates procurement.

Proposed sync: Wed 9/22 10:00am PT works for me. I'll invite our SE (Nandita Rao from Observability Consulting) who can support joint PoC delivery.

I'll attach a short Partner readiness checklist after the sync.

Best,
Sarah Lin
Head of Alliances, Observability Integrations
Grafana Labs

Attachment: (will share partner-readiness-checklist.pdf after call)

From: Matt O'Neill <matt.oneill@datadog.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability bundle commercial sourcing — next steps

Karthik / team —

Datadog is interested in participating in a combined offer, particularly around managed alerting and synthetic checks for prompt regressions. A couple of asks from our side to make this workable for mid-market pilots: 

- We need a draft SOW and a reseller term sheet to run through our finance and marketplace team. If you can pre-populate items (scope, deliverables, acceptance criteria, service levels), we can move faster.
- For marketplace listing / co-sell, we'll need an approved branding pack and a one-time integration QA hurdle.
- Our procurement will likely route contracts through DocuSign; please include the HubSpot deal ID when you send docs (I see you already have HubSpot link) so my ops can attach it.

I can be on the call Wed 9/22 10:00am PT. If legal expects a finalized term sheet before signing, we can use an initial DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/embedded/sign?token=abc123-docu

Thanks,
Matt O'Neill
Partner Sales, Datadog

P.S. Looping in our marketplace PM Jane (will add separately) — she handles listing requirements.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@grafana.com>, Matt O'Neill <matt.oneill@datadog.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 14:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability bundle commercial sourcing — next steps

Thanks all. Quick internal summary and next steps (copying public replies for context):

1) Sync confirmed: Wed 9/22 10:00am PT — calendar invites going out now.
2) Karthik / Redwood: we'll draft the pilot SOW and the reseller term sheet (target: send first draft EOD Thu 9/23). SOW should include scope: dashboard delivery, alerting config, 30-day pilot acceptance window, handover checklist.
3) Grafana: provide SE time (Nandita) and the dashboard packaging plan; estimate ~2-3 weeks for packaged dashboard.
4) Datadog: we'll capture listing requirements and branding pack items; Matt to share marketplace PM contact.
5) Ops: include HubSpot deal ID RWI-DEAL-4381 on all docs and the DocuSign envelope to expedite matching.

Attachments referenced: partner-draft-sku-v1.pdf, commercial-term-sheet.xlsx. I'll create a lightweight one-pager co-sell play after the call and circulate for field feedback.

If anyone needs to adjust the time, flag now — otherwise we proceed.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
